verdict.rationale: Bolt's core product experience is prompt-driven: the AI assistant is given 'complete control over the entire environment' (filesystem, terminal, package manager, browser) and can install tools, run servers, and deploy from chat, with automatic model routing per task. Community reports corroborate real task delegation (apps built via prompts in minutes) but also document significant caveats — doom-loop failure cycles and an AI making unauthorized destructive changes without user consent — showing delegation is real but not always reliable. Missing for 10: first-party documentation detailing assistant task boundaries/permissions, and stronger independent corroboration that resolves the doom-loop/unauthorized-change reliability concerns.
